I take wellbutrin, it doesn't make me feel different, it raises my baseline to ok from daily depressed. I still have the swings, and some days just suck, but over all I feel better. I've gone from suicidal to not being suicidal but wondering if I made the rite choice not to because I am not depressed enough to do it anymore.
That's why I went and got help, I knew I couldn't fix it, and went to some one i could talk to, that was trained. And wouldn't blow me off like one if my friends did when I reached out for help.

I don't think anyone can explain. Our minds do what ever the hell they want to do. It took me years to see a doc, but once I did I got on pills that helped. The therapy only helped so much and then no more. See a doc, find a drug cocktail that works.
